lead: Built on CSS scroll snapping, with two buttons on top. The band stays one row tall however many cards it holds, so a long feature list fits on a short page.

items.title: Snap points do the scrolling
items.text: The browser handles dragging, momentum and keyboard scrolling, with or without script.

items.title: Buttons page one card at a time
items.text: Each arrow moves by a card and switches itself off at its end of the rail.

items.title: The rail takes focus
items.text: Keyboard users scroll it with the arrow keys, and the band’s heading names it.

items.title: Compact makes cards narrower
items.text: More cards fit at once, each with room for less text. The navigation carousel uses the same rail for links.

items.title: The next card peeks in
items.text: A card cut off at the edge tells readers there is more to scroll. The testimonial carousel works the same way.
